description:
The leader of T.T. STAR (Twinkle Twin Star). As one of the Ark's top pop stars, she is currently enjoying a surge in popularity.
Having realized early on that singing and dancing alone are not enough to succeed as a pop star, she has made it a point to frequently appear on different variety shows. While she may seem fragile, she actually possesses a solid sense of self-love and great mental fortitude.

lines.text: What pose would you like me to do? Something cutesy? Maybe a heart? It's the least I can do after you waited for so long.
I appreciate you coming again today! Make sure to cheer extra loud during our performance later, okay?
Be sure to share that video you took on all your socials!
How'd I look on stage? Pretty? Yeah, I know. Hehe!
Did you get the invitation I sent? You've got the best seat in the house, so you have to come.
I went with a kitty pose for today's finisher. Did it remind you of anything, Kitten?
Where are you hiding, Kitten? I have to head out soon for my next gig.
You set up a one-on-one meeting and then leave me hanging? What kind of a fan does that, Kitten? Honestly.
It's so refreshing that I don't have to go all incognito when I'm out here. Want to take a little walk together?
It might be nice to hold a mini concert here sometime.
That girl who just walked by... is she from Prima Donna?!
Hello! We're the two shining stars, Twinkle Twin Star! I'm Mint!
Thanks! Now I'm feeling pumped for our next performance.
Wow, I feel kind of lighter now. Maybe I'll stop by the practice room later.
You're not secretly trying to push me in a direction other than being a pop star, are you?
Thank you! This gives me even more motivation to improve.
Thanks, Kitten. You know, you're the only one who's allowed to give me personal gifts like this.
I always like to give back to my fans, so you can expect a nice little treat from me next time.
Wow, Kitten. Turns out you're more than just a cute face, huh?
Hehehe... Ahem. Come on, Mint. You're a pop star. Get it together!
Pop stars who are new to the game aren't supposed to date, but... I'm not exactly new to this anymore.
Why not take someone else instead of me?
Yes? I'm right here.
Ah, I should have at least made a vlog.
Is this the stage for today's performance?
All right, let's do what we gotta do.
Let's hope I don't get injured...
Cheer for me, okay?
Did you just see what I did?!
Just a sec...
Stand by!
The stage is set!
Get ready for T.T. STAR!
Everyone, sing along!
Did you catch that?
Woohoo!
There's still a lot left...
Ow!
Ack...!
Aw...
That's it for me! Time for a little self-care.
I guess I really was born to perform!
Even in casual clothes, my beauty still shows. I suppose that's just how it is for pop stars.
When I blend into a crowd like this, people don't recognize me as much as you might think.
Flashy styles are lovely too, but I think something simple like this suits me best.
If we're out together like this, people might think we're a couple... What if someone asks to take our picture?
What I'm like offstage is something only you get to see, Kitten.
If I ever retire as a pop star, I guess simple dates like this would just be part of my everyday life.
Are we really just going to stand around like this on our day off?
You're excited about your secret date with a beautiful pop star, aren't you? I'll be waiting, so take your time getting ready.
It's been a while since I've had the chance to enjoy a cup of coffee. Would you like to join me?
I like the off-season. It's nice not having to worry about being watched all the time. Of course, I still make sure to keep myself in shape.
What do I do in my free time? Nothing all that special. Pop stars are just people too, you know. I just take it easy when I can.
Shh! Today, I'm just Mint!
It's our day off, so let's take it easy.
Well? Do I look a little prettier today? For pop stars, appearance really matters, after all.
If I get too strong, it won't really fit my image.
Pop stars aren't swayed by gifts like this... I think.
I'd love to return the favor, so let's go shopping later.
This is for me, and not Mint the pop star, right? ... Thank you, I really appreciate it.
Why does it feel like I'm the one who likes you more...? Shouldn't it be the other way around?
Is this how my fans feel when they see me? That fluttery feeling... like your heart's about to burst?
I've never liked someone this much before, so you should feel honored, Kitten.
Wasn't today supposed to be my day off?
You called?
